A group is a list when its items are plain rows. Items rendered as links or buttons keep their own role, and the group drops the list role so the markup stays valid. Render the group as <l0/> and items as <l1/> wrapping links if you want both.
A grouped list of people. Separators start where the text starts, whatever sits in the media slot, so they line up under the names.

`size` scales padding, gap, corner radius and media together. A group tightens its gap to match.

`variant="grouped"` puts items on one surface. Separators are drawn for you and inset to the text, the first and last rows own the outer corners, and the separators next to a hovered or focused row fade out.

icon puts the icon on a tile and hides it from screen readers. image crops to a square. Both have corners concentric with the item.
